task_description: Complete frontend redesign of the NVLabs dashboard from light theme to dark navy mission-control theme matching the provided screenshot. Includes new sidebar with system status, dark header with search/toggle, and fully redesigned Overview page with stat cards, agent network visualization, pipeline execution, live activity, quick actions, recent tasks, top agents, token/cost chart, and command bar.

verification.summary: TypeScript compilation (tsc -b) and Vite build both pass with zero errors. No test framework configured in this project, so build verification is the primary quality gate. All strict TypeScript checks pass (noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters).
